rows: White: the atrium. The apeiron pool lies beneath an opening in the roof that lets in light, never rain, ringed by gateways to your Reveries, each fed by a euripus (a short floor channel with a bronze sluice: dry, a trickle or running); sealed top-up vessels beside it. The spinning top, your first belief (this is a dream), which makes you Lucid (open: whether it stays here or moves to the library). Calm and Stillness qualities strongest here
Doors to anchored places, for fast travel

Four, opening off a colonnaded peristyle, one per emotion pair, in colour-wheel order: Courage/Fear (N), Joy/Grief (E), Hope/Despair (S), Love/Hate (W). Upper floor = outward emotion, cellar = inward. Crossing stairs where Hope meets Hate and Despair meets Love. Memories and beliefs sit by their strongest colour; split between neighbours = on the boundary or stairs. Beliefs can shift colour and move between visits; memories keep the colour they were felt in. Each floor has shelves and its own reading room, whose desk holds that floor's Musings

On the centre's upper floor: an annular gallery ringing the opening above the apeiron pool, with doors onto the four wings' upper floors (cellars are reached only from below, past the pool). The colourless counterpart of the wings: colourless beliefs and colourless memories (white-flamed oil lamps), with a desk for colourless Musings. Threads, deductions and waking insights; the lexicon of known reactions
Grows ingredients between rests; a flower marks each memory you have burned
Shows your persona; inside, you appear as your core self
The exterior is your body; the interior is your mind

Qualities set each floor's plot (floor space). Rooms and Megara take up plot; loose items and fixtures sit inside them or on the floor's shelves. Every floor starts with at least one room, and always has space for at least that room. Unbuilt plot shows as foundations or courtyard; overflow crowds the stairs. Open: what happens when a plot shrinks below what is built

Qualities style the whole house (see Quality styles). Per aspect: count from the claiming qualities, look from the room, behaviour from the quality. Influence spreads continuously from the quality's home floor as it deepens; features unlock at quality-specific depths or deeds. Faded deep qualities leave remnants

Memories: an oil lamp when Loose, its flame in its emotion's colour (a glowing bead in the outer world); rooted, its tier's form: a hearth (Recollection), a room (Refrain), a great hall (Touchstone); a lamp's brightness shows how fast it is fading, a fading memory gutters, a lost one goes out. Beliefs: a loose leaf on a shelf (Notion), pages on a desk while dwelt on (Musing), a codex in a built-in bookcase (Tenet), a room (Certainty), a great hall around a sealed shrine holding a codex bound in bronze boards (Dogma); covers dyed by emotion, marbled when mixed. Rooms have no voices

Fresh (the room's ruin: burnt, torn out or collapsed), scarred (scar tissue: mismatched tiles, a door to nowhere), healed (sound again, with a visible trace such as lead clamps). The plot is unusable until healed
